title: CS1 Python and Java practice problems with AI-generated subgoal labels
summary: Novice programmers work through 26 practice problems on variables, expressions, conditionals, loops, and arrays with concise subgoal labels that decompose each solution process without revealing code. ChatGPT-4 generates candidate labels for instructor review before they are incorporated into classroom materials.

sources.title: How Good are Large Language Models at Generating Subgoal Labels?
sources.evidence_quote: we prompted ChatGPT 4.0 to generate subgoal labels for 11 and 15 programming practice problems from Python and Java e-books, respectively

assessment.summary: Solve introductory programming practice problems using readable, non-code subgoal labels as process scaffolding.
student_actions: Read a programming problem and its staged subgoal labels.
Translate each subgoal into code and complete the solution.
